Swap uses two services K doesn\'t run. Read and agree to both before you continue.

Swaps between Kaspa and coins on other networks (Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDC, USDT and others) are made by ChangeNOW, a third-party exchange. K only asks ChangeNOW for a quote and a deposit address and shows the swap\'s status; ChangeNOW does the exchange and sends the coins. K isn\'t responsible for failed, delayed or lost swaps. If one doesn\'t go through, contact ChangeNOW\'s support.
I understand ChangeNOW is a third party, not K, and I agree to ChangeNOW\'s Terms of Use.

Swaps between KAS and kUSDT go through Trestly\'s pool on Kaspa. Trestly is a third party: it issues kUSDT and runs the pool, not K. Trestly\'s own code prices each swap and builds its transaction; K shows it to you, signs it with your address\'s key only after you approve, and sends it. Prices move, and the pool can be paused or limit sells. K isn\'t responsible for the pool, the token or a swap\'s outcome.
